misprints.note: Genitive ending printed with a grave accent instead of an acute.
πῦρ printed with an acute instead of a circumflex; elsewhere on the page it has the circumflex.

uncertain.note: The circumflex sits over the ι of εια, so it is written εῖα. The ending ύ has an acute and no breathing.
Printed 'o-' at the end of a line and 'eg.' on the next. Written 'oeg.' to match the book's usual form, treating the hyphen as a line-break hyphen.
